Brad has confirmed a time that works for all four partners. My next step is to book the meeting in the firm's booking system as he requested. I will use the `create_booking` function with the day and start time Brad provided. After that, I need to inform Brad that the booking has been made so he can send the confirmation email. I'll add an entry to the shared workspace to let him know. This will complete our assigned tasks.Okay, Brad has found a time that works for everyone. I'll book the meeting for Thursday at 14:30 and then let him know it's done.
